AggregatorContent.title: AggregatorContent
AggregatorContent.description: A daily legal news topic, ready-made Facebook post, or short video script written by the external AI aggregator system via Firebase Admin SDK and managed by law firm staff.

title.description: Headline of the legal news topic, post, or video script.

summary.description: Two-line Arabic summary of the news item.

legal_angle.description: Explanation of why this news topic matters legally in Egypt.

type.description: Content item type: topic, post, or script.

topic_id.description: Optional parent topic document ID linking a post or script to its topic.

post_text.description: Full ready-to-publish Facebook post text (only when type = post).

script_text.description: Full spoken short-video script text (only when type = script).

duration_sec.description: Estimated speaking duration in seconds (only when type = script).

source_name.description: Name of the Egyptian news source.

source_url.description: URL link to the original news article.

status.description: Editorial workflow status updated by the authenticated firm admin.

content_date.description: Africa/Cairo calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) this content belongs to.

AggregatorDateIndex.title: AggregatorDateIndex
AggregatorDateIndex.description: Daily index document maintained by the external aggregator (document ID = YYYY-MM-DD) storing the content_date, item count, and updated_at timestamp.

count.description: Total number of aggregator_content documents for this date.

updated_at.description: Server-written Firestore Timestamp of the last update for this day.

/aggregator_content/{docId}.description: Daily legal topics, Facebook posts, and video scripts written server-side by the external aggregator and read/status-updated by the authenticated admin.

/aggregator_dates/{dateId}.description: Lightweight per-day date index (one document per YYYY-MM-DD) read by the authenticated admin to populate the archive dates sidebar without scanning aggregator_content.
